
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/bkyqtr/p/19141193" title="发布于 2025-10-14 15:17">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Sql Server安装报错“服务没有及时响应启动或控制请求”</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>最近由于电脑环境有问题重装了下电脑系统，重装系统后在安装sql server的时候，前面都没有问题<img alt="sqlserver安装防火墙警告" width="579" height="305" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014114602653-1354355682.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>除了有个防火墙警告，看到“<strong>上面提示操作完成。已通过4。失败0。警告1。已跳过0</strong>”，警告警告呗，反正又不是失败，总体还是通过的，心想能怎么着<img alt="guolaidawoa" width="106" height="106" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014140149973-861539712.jpg" class="lazyload">。然后继续后面的下一步操作。最后“<strong><em>报应</em></strong>”来了，开始有多嚣张现在就有多打脸<img alt="qiaobaniguande" width="114" height="114" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014140351456-1227212866.jpg" class="lazyload">&nbsp;→<img alt="papadalian" width="111" height="117" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014140649195-116949802.jpg" class="lazyload">出现大问题了<img alt="nikan" width="70" height="71" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014152958442-1825779175.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="sqlserver服务没有及时响应" width="523" height="459" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014142257441-1268163711.png" class="lazyload">那我重试，依旧是这样<img alt="sqlserver服务没有及时响应重试" width="525" height="396" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014142411285-193216659.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>那我“<strong>取消</strong>”行吧，看安装结果<img alt="sqlserver服务没有及时响应结果" width="652" height="260" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014142738628-1246410002.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>再看下这个失败的详情和日志<img alt="sqlserver服务没有及时响应详情" width="653" height="315" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014142829969-211676505.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>好，看完了，完全没看懂啥意思，也看日志了真没看懂是什么玩意，心想我看下任务管理器对应的服务有没有启动吧　　任务管理器》服务　　在这里面你能看到MSSQLSERVER服务的<strong>状态</strong>是<strong><em>已停止</em></strong></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="654" height="88" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014143513118-449359886.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>然后你在MSSQLSERVER服务上　　鼠标右键》开始，开始后马上会再变回</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="654" height="88" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014143513118-449359886.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="chijing" width="95" height="75" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014152632346-403461481.jpg" class="lazyload">我靠误会大了，服务起不来<img alt="wozhenfule" width="77" height="77" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014152747343-1561583242.jpg" class="lazyload">经过博主多次测试后发现是最开始防火墙没有关闭的原因，然后在重装在安装之前找到　　控制面板》系统和安全》Windows Defender 防火墙》启用或关闭Windows Defender 防火墙》关闭Windows Defender 防火墙（<em><strong>温馨提示关闭所有的防火墙</strong></em>），如下步骤图</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="360" height="180" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014144757011-645490715.png" class="lazyload">》<img alt="image" width="283" height="187" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014145100703-990485457.png" class="lazyload">》</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="432" height="128" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014145515458-981850257.png" class="lazyload">》<img alt="image" width="316" height="259" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014145711788-1808745545.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>关闭后的效果图</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="502" height="167" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014145343324-2034799179.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>然后再去运行Sql Server安装程序就好了，最后没有再提示“<strong>服务没有及时响应启动或控制请求</strong>”了，MSSQLSERVER服务是正常启动的了，如图</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="726" height="96" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1593891/202510/1593891-20251014143320386-1597689001.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>如果还没有解决该问题，可以参考下面网址试试</p>
<p><a href="https://www.jb51.net/database/294046gle.htm" rel="noopener nofollow">安装SQL&nbsp;server出现“服务没有及时响应启动或控制请求”的解决方案_Mysql_脚本之家</a><br><a href="https://blog.csdn.net/yihuajack/article/details/123832707" rel="noopener nofollow">SQL Server 2019安装错误0x80004005 服务没有及时响应启动或控制请求详细解决方法-CSDN博客</a></p>
